class.name: Separator
class.description: Abstract base class for separators, used for separating other controls. [Separator]s are purely visual and normally drawn as a [StyleBox].

theme_items.theme_item: The size of the area covered by the separator. Effectively works like a minimum width/height.

The style for the separator line. Set [member StyleBox.background_color] for its color and [member StyleBox.minimum_size] for its thickness: [code]Vector2(0, thickness)[/code] for [HSeparator], or [code]Vector2(thickness, 0)[/code] for [VSeparator].
